overview_description.description:
If you’re tired of spending $ X0k+ and months on ESOP, contracts, compliance, fundraising, cross-border work, employment, or tech, we built Arcline for you. 

Arcline’s 50+ AI-native lawyers works at startup speed and price. So you can sell, raise, hire, and launch in hours, not months.

Arcline lawyers are trained at top schools (Harvard, Stanford, Oxford) and leading firms (Cooley, Goodwin, Fenwick). Trusted by founders backed by YC, Sequoia, a16z, Founders Fund.

We’re delivering the same top tier legal help to you, without the usual delay or cost. 

Think of us as your fractional in-house legal team, ready to deploy when needed.

about_short_description.short_description: Moritz is a legal company that provides legal services using artificial intelligence.

product.name: Arcline AI
product.description: An AI-powered legal solution for document drafting, legal research, and document review integrated with Microsoft Word and a standalone platform.

product.name: eDiscovery Tool
product.description: A tool within Arcline that extracts and structures key insights from large document sets to support legal decision-making.

product.name: Legal Research Module
product.description: An AI-driven module that identifies and applies relevant legal precedents and sources from EU and domestic law to support case work.

product.name: AI Co-Counsel
product.description: An AI assistant that supports everyday legal tasks such as drafting emails, translations, and providing legal sparring.
